notes.title: The Next Fest started, and we are part of it!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114476/ac044f8ce38c892f8e96d0e4d9588f162641c35e.jpg

Thanks to Steam, The Battle for Vega it's part of the currently running Steam Next Fest, and we are very grateful to be there! As part of the patch cycle a few adjustments were made to the demo version:

 Leaderboards: Now the top 3 ranks will be shown on top of the list as a whole
 Home: Added the control scheme in the home screen, as well as the ranking of your friends
 Arcade: Even when a run it's not fully complete we still send score data to the leaderboards, and you can see your position right there
 Gameplay: Thanks to a tester, and good friend of mine all of the flying enemies (the ones that leave the grid) will show a small positioning mark where they will return after the fly, this will make hunting for the last few flyers a bit easier to everybody!

notes.title: Battle for Vega official demo version is out!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114476/79cb2f279ec2715cdb4162dab31bf5fb2ba4f1af.jpg

 What is The Battle for Vega?

Inspired by the classic Space Invaders, The Battle for Vega takes the old-school gameplay you know and love and adds new features that make it a fresh and exciting experience.

In The Battle for Vega, you'll face off against waves of enemies and bosses across multiple star systems. Each enemy type has a unique weapon, so you'll need to strategize and adapt to their attacks if you want to survive. But don't worry – you'll have plenty of weapons of your own to choose from.

Every player ship type has different hardpoints that you can equip with different weapons classes and types. Choose from a wide range of options, including lasers, missiles, and more. As you progress through the game, you'll be able to upgrade your ships and weapons for better stats and performance. Will you focus on firepower or speed? The choice is yours.

But be careful – the enemies in The Battle for Vega are relentless, and they won't give up without a fight! You'll need to be quick on your feet and even quicker with your trigger finger if you want to make it through to the end.

With its classic gameplay, modern upgrades, and challenging levels, The Battle for Vega is a must-play for fans of retro shooters. Get ready to blast your way through the galaxy and emerge victorious in the ultimate battle for Vega!

What's in the demo version?

The demo version contains the first 3 player ships, most of hardpoint class 1 weapons, and selected hardpoint class 2 weapons. You can play through 15 levels up to the first boss - this includes bonus levels, and even HARD version of the boss.

On top of that you have a separated Arcade Mode in which you play through the whole game with no credits, upgrades, or level directives. Each act has a predefined ship, so everybody plays on a plain field and can try to reach best time, or hi score.
